notes.title: Version 2.3.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
4th of July Bash: A time-limited independence adventure island awaits! Dive into exclusive quests, claim login bonuses, and exchange them for awesome rewards!

PvP Arena: Challenge shopkeepers from around the world to climb the ranks and prove your heroes’ valor as you compete for leaderboard prizes!

Blueprint Collection: Track and complete your blueprint collection to reach key milestones and unlock exclusive rewards!

notes.title: Version 2.0.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
Christmas Wonderland:
A time-limited Christmas adventure island awaits! Dive into exclusive quests, claim login bonuses, and exchange them for magical holiday-themed rewards!

notes.title: Version 1.9.5 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[u]Bounty Tasks[/u]
Send up to 5 teams of designated heroes on daily tasks to earn exclusive artifacts for crafting exclusive hero-bound weapons
Bounty quests require specific equipment with matching mastery levels and heroes with corresponding star levels to begin
Borrow up to 2 heroes from other shopkeepers within your guild every 24 hours for bounty quests

[u]Exclusive Hero-Bound Weapons[/u]
Unlock an exclusive hero-bound weapon slot and limited blueprint by meeting the required relationship level for each hero
Each hero has a unique weapon that can only be equipped by them after unlocking its hero-bound weapon slot
Hero-bound blueprints have limited crafting quantities and can no longer be crafted once exhausted (required artifacts for crafting can be obtained through daily bounty quests)
Each hero has a set of achievements that continuously enhance their hero-bound weapon’s stats as they are completed, allowing the weapon to grow alongside the hero
All achievements are tied to the hero, and progress-related buffs will be transferred to the hero-exclusive weapon when replaced

[u]Anniversary Bonus Login [/u](available for 7days)
Celebrate Shop Legends' 1st Anniversary with a week of exclusive free rewards!

[b]New Adventure Island[/b] (available for 7 days Nov 26, 2024 0:00UTC ~ Dec 2, 2024 23:59:59UTC)
Send your heroes on the time-limited Adventures to loot exclusive Thanksgiving Vouchers
Each adventure will grant limited themed equipment with a +100% battle power bonus when equipped
Vouchers can be exchanged in the Thanksgiving Shop to redeem awesome and exclusive rewards
Daily Thanksgiving task chains can be completed to earn bonus vouchers (refreshed daily)
Exchange will still be available for an additional 24 hours after the event is over (cannot loot additional vouchers)

[b]Thanksgiving Daily Login [/b](available for 7days)
Login daily to claim free Thanksgiving exclusive vanity furniture & avatar customization

[u]Forge Master's Showdown:[/u] Bi-Weekly Event (available for 3days starting Dec 3, 2024)
Choose 1-3 equipment subtypes per showdown to compete in, earning points by submitting equipment crafted from owned blueprints
Each equipment can be submitted up to five times, from Normal to Legendary quality (lower-quality equipment can be replaced with its higher-quality versions during the event)
Higher-quality equipment submissions will earn more points, while all submitted equipment grant gold and EXP, which will be delivered at the event's end along with ranking rewards
Compete on individual equipment subtype leaderboards and a combined equipment subtype leaderboard for up to 4x the ranking rewards (separate but identical rewards for each line)
Gain bonus event points based on the number of mastery milestones activated across the selected equipment lines (bonus stacks with Forge Master's Pass bonus)
Unlock premium ranking rewards and enjoy a +50% event points bonus across all equipment submissions with a Forge Master's Pass  (bonus stacks with mastery bonus) 

[b]Balancing & Optimizations[/b]
Energy Formula Optimization: Adjusted energy gain/loss to scale with customer favorability levels
Fusion Blueprint Improvements: Prevented unlocking of already-owned blueprints
Battle Preview Buffs: Added ATK/DEF buff displays from city investments
TradeHouse Dual Currency: Listings now display both gold and gem prices 
Resource Management Enhancements: Tooltips and quick navigation added for storage/regen increases
Social Coin Rewards: Shopkeepers will now earn Social Coins each time their hero is borrowed for a bounty quest
Added hero resting time protection for each adventure: heroes below the protection level will no longer need to rest after losing a battle
Added status effect buff/debuff icons and descriptions during battle
Adjusted customer relationship EXP: now based on equipment level vs. shopkeeper level, with higher-level equipment yielding more EXP
Increased equipment durability consumption by +300% for all blueprints with this buff
Reduced battle power requirements and monster levels across all adventures and dungeons
Reduced treasure bag opening timer across all adventure levels
Increased base sales price for all chest and event blueprint equipment
Added price sorting option in the suggestion screen

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed hero summoning shopkeeper's skill resetting the legendary customer cooldown time
Resolved loud audio feedback from shaking to batch collect crafted equipment
Corrected display issues for instrument and projectile icons in the TradeHouse
Fixed a bug where crafting exceptional quality equipment required the animation to finish before closing
Fixed a bug where Apocalypse Mode leaderboard rewards weren't automatically sent or refreshed
Fixed a bug where the recommended guild list wasn’t displaying properly
Fixed mastery bonus bugs not taking effect during battles
Fixed a bug where the crafting icon on the HUD occasionally disappeared
Fixed all battle-related bugs regarding unit targeting
Fixed all battle-related bugs with buffs and debuffs
Fixed all skill-related bugs to ensure they take effect as intended
Fixed a bug where auto-fusion didn’t unlock fusion blueprints properly
Fixed a bug where auto-transmutation didn’t apply the double transmutation %
Fixed a bug where legendary fusions from auto-fusion didn’t tally correctly in the fusion report

[u]New Packs[/u]
[b]Level Packs[/b] (Lv.110 &  Lv.120) 
Advanced Gacha Cards x18
Shopkeeper Skills x66
Tier 11-12 Chests & Keys

notes.title: Version 1.7.0 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[u]New Seasons' Mode:[/u]
In the grand decree of His Majesty Wren, a new season will dawn every 6-12 months, each infused with a distinct theme as Aragonia seeks to expand its reach beyond its borders. The inaugural season will be adorned with a Cute theme. Gather themed furniture and avatar decor to amass season scores, climbing the ranks of the seasonal leaderboard. Possessing themed treasures increases your score, and when displayed in your shop or worn, they grant an astounding 3x bonus.

As the season concludes, the finest shopkeepers will ascend to the legendary Shop of the Season contest, where all players will collectively votes for the ultimate victor. With higher placement on the season leaderboards comes greater fame and visibility for voting. The champions will claim exclusive rewards such as hero skins imbued with new powers, exclusive master craftsmen, and rare blueprints.

[b]Season Achievements:[/b]
At season’s end, your heroic endeavors are measured across all categories of gameplay, earning you a 1-5 rating per domain. Rewards abound in each category, and your combined ratings unlock your season achievement level, marked by a prestigious trophy bestowing permanent buffs and a season-exclusive avatar frame.

While the next season resets your shop, your legacy endures in the Hall of Triumphs, where past glories and trophies are enshrined for eternity. All In-App Purchases and core progress—special craftsmen, unique slots, event blueprints/furniture, the Growth Fund, workstation skins, Wishing Well, and Fountains—carry forward unscathed. Your previous unlocked slots and ascended heroes will also remain steadfast.

Unused consumables—skills, runes, motivation/gacha cards, relic shards, blueprint frags, repair cards, manuals, buffs, potions III+ are preserved in your inventory, awaiting the next season's challenges.

In addition, chest blueprints will return keys according to the blueprint's respective level. 

Mastery manuals will return, ready for redistribution. Blueprints from the exchange revert to their fragment form. Premium furniture and avatars purchased with gems return their value in full, or even higher. Relic shard blueprints revert to their original shards value for immediate re-use.

Chests, equipment, and levels (heroes, craftsmen, shopkeeper) will be reset, but fear not—these, too, contribute to your seasonal achievements and rewards, propelling you to new heights of glory!

Fusion blueprints up to Tier 5 will be retained, while all others will yield Destiny Runes based on the blueprint's level,

[b]Season Start:[/b]
Kick off the season by strategically selecting from a series of randomly generated buffs for your craftsmen, heroes, resource bins and equipment lines to boost throughout the season (buffs may be reselected twice after initial selection)
Participate in this season's Race to the Top event, awarding up to 300 legendary hero fragments, among other awesome rewards, to the top placing shopkeepers (lasts 2 weeks, after which time Raid & Royal Decree will kick off again)

Locked equipment can now be submitted to the Craftsmanship Statue without manually unlocking

Displayed artifact ranges based on difficulty level
Allowed suggesting any equipment category to customers at a 75% price discount
Mass lock/unlock feature added to inventory

Advanced Gacha now ensures 50 hero shards per draw, regular gold/silver Gacha draw will also ensures 50 shards
Increased fusion blueprints' battle power and chest blueprints' gold sales prices
Added 12 more accumulated rewards to the Wishing Well

notes.title: Version 1.4.0 Release Note
notes.notes:
[u]Apocalypse Mode:[/u]
Defeat bosses across each adventure island to accumulate progress towards activating apocalypse mode
With apocalypse mode activated, a limited number of attempts to challenge each dungeon will be granted
All dungeons will provide 3x the amount of artifact drops and rare loot drops, along with a higher rare drop chance
After all available attempts to challenge an activated apocalypse mode adventure island, the boss counter will reset and can be accumulated again
Successfully challenging dungeons will earn corresponding points towards the Apocalypse Mode Leaderboards

[u]Transmutation[/u]
Transform potions, chests, keys, runes, artifacts, and consumables into its higher level counterparts using the Transmutation Furnace
Unlockable at Lv. 21 by hiring Mizuki the Enchantress to your team (skills: Catalyzing - increasing fusion success rate across all equipment types & Transmuting - reducing transmutation time for all consumables) 
Advanced Transmutation Slots not only reduce the required consumables for each transmutation but also reduce transmutation time by 35% and increase the chance of doubling the transmutation outcome by 5%
By activating Mizuki, you'll enjoy a 15% fusion speed buff bond with all other craftsmen, benefiting every equipment type (Mizuki will gain EXP with each successful fusion outcome) 

[b]Optimizations/Balancing:[/b]
Added an accumulated 10-draw progress bonus for premium Gacha draws (every tenth premium draw now rewards two additional premium flips at no extra cost)
Added an exclusive craftsmen slot to be available with the activation of both fountains (not retroactive for those already with both fountains activated)
Fusion failures will now provide a 30% chance of material refunds (previously exclusive to advanced fusion slots) while failing fusion using an advanced fusion slot will now have a 50% chance to return the equipment consumed and an additional 50% to refund materials when eqiupment are not returned
Revamped hero lores (preparing to add gem rewards for unlocking and viewing each hero story)
Added a new hero ascension animation and display when ascending from 5 gold stars to 1 diamond star
Significantly increased the amount of event points for contributing fusion-born & relic shard equipment during the Royal Decree 
Added new filtering options to the fusion UI
Improved filtering options across the TradeHouse
Added various new triggered tutorials to optimize new player experience
Implemented a jump option within the guild donation request interface, facilitating quick crafting
Introduced floaters for all guild donations to enhance visibility
Revised the daily task chest rewards preview to showcase all possible rewards rather than a random selection
Added VIP customer designation and displayed equipment type affinity on the customer transaction UI
Drastically reduced the number of event medals required for Boss Raids and adjusted required battle power for each stage (required power is based on individual progress)
Reduced event points required for lower tiers in the Royal Decree while increasing points required for higher tiers to accomodate new players while further challenge top guilds
Expanded the Primier Patron Leaderboards with an additional 190 ranking rewards, now recognizing the top 200 players weekly
Introduced a one-tap option to quickly remove all craftsmen (will be tuning craftsmen emotion timers to remain static after 1hour of inactivity with the next update)
Added a one-tap feature to automatically create a formation of heroes based on most optimized heroes available for adventuring
Optimized localization across multiple languages

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
Rectified an issue where certain customers were requesting lower quality items than what was available on shelves
Addressed a bug in Power Auto Crafting where the auto-refill function would persistently remain activated, now automatically deactivating when not available
Corrected a calculation error in the mastery of the Craftsmen Statue that was previously inaccurate
Fixed a bug where the Premium Gacha Card would occassionally reset the accumulated draw progress for regular Gacha draws

notes.title: Version 1.2.8 Release Notes
notes.notes:
[u]Guild Donations:[/u]
Enhance your guild's cooperation with special order customers (multi-order, impatient, and legendary). 
Guildmates can now respond to donation requests directly in guild chat or via the requesting shopkeeper within your shop. 
When you donate equipment, you'll not only receive the corresponding EXP for selling it but also Social Tokens as a reward for your generosity.

[u]Guild Gifts:[/u]
Elevate your guild's experience by purchasing any pack priced at $79.99 USD or higher, and trigger an automatic guild-wide gem gift. 
Every member is eligible to claim their share! Watch for the gem gift in guild chat - it's available on a first-come, first-served basis, with the prize pool varying from 500 to 1500+ gems.

[u]Royal Decree Event:[/u]
Join forces with your guild to provide King Wren with essential armaments, fortifying Aragonia against an impending invasion. This event offers 30 tiers of rewards, accessible to all guild members.

[b]Collective and Individual Requirements:[/b] Each reward tier unlocks when the guild achieves certain event point milestones. Individual members must meet specific shopkeeper level and contribution minimums to claim their rewards.

[b]Participation Rules:[/b] New guilds or members joining after the event starts cannot participate in the current event and must wait for the next one. If you leave your guild mid-event, you forfeit the ability to participate further or claim additional prizes.

[b]Bonus Points:[/b] Contributing three specified types of bonus equipment and one designated equipment yields +150% bonus event points at each tier. Additionally, continuously investing gold and gems can increase event points by up to 350%, with bonuses stacking as each currency reaches 100% donation progress.

[b]Royal Decree Event Pass: [/b]Activate this pass for access to a premium reward line, free from individual restrictions like shopkeeper level or minimum contributions to maximize your event earnings.

[b]Event Rewards:[/b] The top 10 ranked guilds will receive an exclusive time-limited emblem as well as collective guild buff (available to all qualifying and participating members) and the MVP(s) of each category (points contributed, gold invested, gems invested) will each also receive an exclusive time-limited avatar frame, these rewards are available at the end of the event while milestone tier rewards are available to collect immediately as they become unlocked and available.

[b]Claiming Rewards:[/b] Unclaimed event prizes remain claimable for 24 hours post-event. After this period, unclaimed rewards will be sent via in-game mail.
